emails.name: Welcome
emails.subject: Welcome to Kettlewick
emails.preheader: Your code for 15% off the first bag, and what to expect from us.
emails.summary: Sent once, straight after someone joins the list.
handles: Hidden preheader followed by spacer characters, so the inbox preview stops where it should
VML roundrect button for Outlook on Windows, with a styled link for every other client
Logo badge with its own background, readable in light and dark inboxes
Dashed code box and numbered steps built from table cells, so they show with images off
Dark mode through prefers-color-scheme, repeated for Outlook.com with data-ogsc and data-ogsb
Plain text version with every link written out

emails.name: Order confirmation
emails.subject: Order KW-20418 is confirmed
emails.preheader: Thanks, Jamie. We roast your coffee on Tuesday and post it on Wednesday morning.
emails.summary: Sent when an order is paid. Lists the items, the totals and where the order is going.
handles: Line items in a real data table with column and row headers, so a screen reader can follow it
Line totals, the discount and the total worked out at build time from unit prices, then checked again by the tests
Delivery and payment details in two fluid hybrid columns that stack on phones without a media query
Ghost tables in Outlook conditional comments keep those columns side by side in Outlook
Thumbnails sized by width and height attributes, so Outlook on a high DPI screen keeps them at 56 pixels
Figures right aligned with tabular numbers

emails.name: Shipping update
emails.subject: Your coffee is on its way
emails.preheader: Order KW-20418 left the roastery today. Harbour Post expects to deliver it on Friday 23 October.
emails.summary: Sent when the parcel is handed to the carrier, with tracking and a delivery estimate.
handles: Tracking button in VML for Outlook and a 48 pixel tall link everywhere else
Four step progress bar made of table cells with bgcolor, so it shows with images off
Tracking number in a monospaced face with letter spacing, and format detection off so iOS leaves it alone
Brew tip callout with its own dark mode colours
Every link and button is at least 44 pixels tall

emails.name: Newsletter
emails.subject: Roast notes: a Kenya and a Guatemala for November
emails.preheader: Two new coffees, the brew ratio we use on the bar and a free cupping on Saturday 14 November.
emails.summary: Roast notes, the monthly email. A hero, a product grid, a brew tip and an event.
handles: Two column product grid in fluid hybrid columns, side by side at 600 pixels and stacked on phones even when a client strips media queries
Media queries widen the stacked cards and images to the full width as an enhancement
Young Serif headings where web fonts load, with Georgia as the fallback that Outlook is held to
Full width hero that scales with height auto, sized for Outlook by its width and height attributes
Outline buttons in VML as well, so all six buttons stay buttons in Outlook
Unsubscribe and preference links in the footer, each a full size tap target
